text:
Maya (CS): Helios PM Sam asks for a temporary proxy allowlist + QPS bump for their EU-1 launch next Tue. They flagged renewal if perf isn't solid. Can Edge/Infra help provision?

Jun (Edge): Need exact CIDRs + precise time window. Are they using our proxy peering or direct peering? mTLS?

Maya (CS): Proxy peering. No mTLS for this demo. Window: 2026-03-31T00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T00:00Z. Primary bump = 3x for first 24h, then 1.5x for next 24h. CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/25. Customer contact: sam@helios.com

Rohan (CSE): Suggest canary in eu-1a for first 30m, throttle back on error rate, then full roll after green. Also attach the perf eval prompts to monitoring.

ops-bot: Policy check: temporary QPS >500 or >48h needs Infra approval. Creating ticket: INC-20260331-7.

Ava (Infra): We have ~30% spare in eu-1. Can provision ephemeral capacity but need ~4h lead. We'll add proxy ACL entries and a rollout policy: canary -> 50% -> 100% over 45m. Also will add automatic fallback to the smaller model if latency spikes.

Jun (Edge): Can implement ACL + routing change. Please confirm the final desired token QPS numbers.

Maya (CS): Final numbers: baseline 720 qps -> 2160 qps for 24h, then 1080 qps next 24h.

Jun (Edge): Ack. Applying ACL to proxy-peers eu-1 now.

Jun (Edge): ACL applied to proxy-peers eu-1 (198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/25) at 2026-03-30T19:00Z. Routing policy updated with canary plan. Ticket INC-20260331-7 updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20260331-7

Ava (Infra): Provisioned ephemeral capacity and bound to dedicated pool; autoscaler rules set. Will run a smoke check 30m before start. Post-launch check scheduled 4h after start.

Maya (CS): :thumbsup: I'll inform Sam and ask them to run their smoke traffic during the canary window. Also noting renewal signal — customer said launch perf is gating the contract signature.

Rohan (CSE): I'll attach the eval hooks and the user prompt set to the monitoring dash so we can detect regressions quickly.

Ava (Infra): Everything staged. If we see >2% 5xx or >10% 429s during canary we'll abort and fallback.

Jun (Edge): Leaving the thread open until 8h post-launch then will mark resolved.

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — will update Sam and close the loop after launch.
